title: Come Celebrate with God
traveler_why: Willow is the Traveler who welcomes people in, and tonight King Hezekiah invites the whole land to God’s house: Willow invites the whole street to a picnic, and the ones who come share the joy.
traveler_about: Willow fits tonight because Willow loves to welcome people in, and tonight a king sends invitations to the whole land. In Willow’s world today: Willow makes paper invitations for a picnic in the backyard, one for every house on the street. One neighbor says no thanks, and Willow feels a little sad. But the new family at the end of the street comes, and so does old Mr. Lee with his ukulele. Everyone sings and eats and laughs together on the big blanket. Just like King Hezekiah, Willow learned that God’s invitation is for everyone, and the ones who come find great joy.
